title: RPG Design Guides: Enhancement Systems (Growth Systems)

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】強化システム（成長システム）
blocks.translation: RPG Design Guides: Enhancement Systems (Growth Systems)

blocks.source: 『強化システム』とはキャラクターの能力を伸ばしたり、新たな技を覚えるためのシステムのことである。
blocks.translation: An “enhancement system” is a system for improving a character’s abilities or learning new techniques.

blocks.source: ＲＰＧにおいては、戦闘システムに次いで作品のウリになることが多い。一般には『成長システム』とも呼ばれるが、『装備』まで『成長』と表現して良いものか悩むので、本項では強化システムとしてまとめて扱う。
blocks.translation: In RPGs, it is often one of a game’s main selling points, second only to the battle system. It is generally also called a “growth system,” but since I am unsure whether it is appropriate to describe even equipment as “growth,” I will group everything together under enhancement systems in this section.

blocks.source: 強化システムは、主にキャラクター自体を強化する『成長型』と、装備を強化する『装備型』の２種類に分類できる。
blocks.translation: Enhancement systems can primarily be divided into two types: “growth-based,” which strengthens the characters themselves, and “equipment-based,” which strengthens their equipment.

blocks.source: 一般的に成長型は経験値（ＦＦのＡＰなど、独自ポイントも含む）によって、強化する場合が多く、装備型はお金や素材アイテムに依存する場合が多い。ただし例外も多数ある。
blocks.translation: Generally, growth-based systems are often improved through experience points (including unique points such as Final Fantasy’s AP), while equipment-based systems often depend on money or material items. However, there are many exceptions.

blocks.source: 強化システムの目的は主に４つ挙げられる。
blocks.translation: There are four main purposes for enhancement systems.

blocks.source: 変化をつけて、プレイヤーを飽きさせなくする。
blocks.translation: Add variety and keep the player from becoming bored.

blocks.source: 努力の蓄積が実を結ぶことを表現し、達成感を演出する。
blocks.translation: Express how accumulated effort bears fruit and create a sense of accomplishment.

blocks.source: 戦略性、戦術性を強化し、ゲーム性を向上させる。
blocks.translation: Enhance strategic and tactical depth to improve the gameplay.

blocks.source: ストーリーを補強する。長い冒険の中でキャラクターを鍛え上げたのだからこそ、強敵に勝つだけの説得力が生まれる。
blocks.translation: Reinforce the story. Because the characters have honed their skills throughout a long adventure, defeating powerful enemies becomes more convincing.

blocks.source: 何十時間と掛かる長編ＲＰＧにおいて、プレイヤーを退屈させないためには、強化システムの存在が不可欠である。
blocks.translation: In a long-form RPG that takes dozens of hours to complete, an enhancement system is essential for keeping the player from getting bored.

blocks.source: 特に……
blocks.translation: In particular…

blocks.source: 戦闘する → レベルが上がって、より強い敵に勝てるようになる → 強敵と戦闘する → ……
blocks.translation: Fight → Level up and become able to defeat stronger enemies → Fight a powerful enemy → …

blocks.source: といったループは単純ながら、プレイヤーにとって強力な原動力に成りうる。ＲＰＧの基本要素の１つと言ってしまってもよい。
blocks.translation: Although simple, a loop like this can be a powerful motivating force for players. You could even call it one of the fundamental elements of an RPG.

blocks.source: そんなわけで、ＲＰＧにおいて欠かせない強化システムを取り扱ってみる。
blocks.translation: With that in mind, I will take a look at the enhancement systems that are indispensable to RPGs.

blocks.source: 例によって、市販ＲＰＧでよく使用されているシステムを分類してみた。
blocks.translation: As usual, I have classified systems commonly used in commercial RPGs.

blocks.source: レベル制（経験値制）
blocks.translation: Level-Based (Experience Point-Based)

blocks.source: 戦闘を行うことで、経験値を入手する。経験値が一定に達すると、レベルが上がると同時に全体の能力が上昇する。
blocks.translation: Characters gain experience points by fighting battles. When their experience reaches a certain amount, they level up and their overall abilities increase.

blocks.source: 多くの作品で採用されているが、これだけでは単純なので、他のシステムと組み合わせられることが多い。
blocks.translation: Although this system is used in many games, it is simple on its own, so it is often combined with other systems.

blocks.source: 長所
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: 分かりやすくプレイヤーも制作者も手間がかからない。
blocks.translation: It is easy to understand and requires little effort from either the player or the developer.

blocks.source: キャラクター毎の個性を維持しやすい。
blocks.translation: It is easy to preserve each character’s individuality.

blocks.source: 単純ゆえにバランス調整も比較的に容易。
blocks.translation: Because it is simple, balancing is comparatively easy.

blocks.source: 短所
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: 単純ゆえに自由度は低い。
blocks.translation: Because it is simple, it offers little freedom.

blocks.source: レベル制（経験値・活躍分配型）
blocks.translation: Level-Based (Experience Point and Contribution Distribution)

blocks.source: ＳＲＰＧでよく用いられるレベル制。
blocks.translation: A level-based system often used in strategy RPGs.

blocks.source: 戦闘で敵にとどめを刺すなど、活躍したキャラに対して経験値を与える。
blocks.translation: Experience points are awarded to characters who make significant contributions in battle, such as delivering the finishing blow to an enemy.

blocks.source: 上と異なり参加するだけで経験値が手に入るわけではない。
blocks.translation: Unlike the system above, characters do not gain experience simply by participating.

blocks.source: 長所
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: キャラクター毎の個性を維持しやすい。
blocks.translation: It is easy to preserve each character’s individuality.

blocks.source: 誰を優先して育てるかを考える楽しさがある。
blocks.translation: It is fun to consider which characters to prioritize when training.

blocks.source: 短所
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: 活躍できないキャラは成長の機会に乏しくなる。
blocks.translation: Characters who cannot contribute have few opportunities to grow.

blocks.source: レベルを上げたいキャラでとどめを刺すために、周りの強いキャラでチクチクとボスのＨＰを減らすといった調整作業が発生する。
blocks.translation: Players may have to perform tedious adjustments, such as repeatedly chipping away at a boss’s HP with stronger surrounding characters so that the character they want to level up can deliver the finishing blow.

blocks.source: スパロボの幸運（経験値＆お金倍増）などの精神コマンドは、この短所をさらに顕著にしている。
blocks.translation: Mental Commands such as Super Robot Wars’ Luck (which doubles experience and money) make this disadvantage even more pronounced.

blocks.source: 「工夫をすると経験値が増える」ということは「工夫をしないと経験値が減る（相対的に）」とほぼ同義だからだ。敵を倒すのにもいちいち気を使わなければならない。
blocks.translation: That is because “using ingenuity increases your experience” is almost equivalent to “not using ingenuity decreases your experience (relatively speaking).” You have to be careful every time you defeat an enemy.

blocks.source: 対案として……
blocks.translation: Possible alternatives include…

blocks.source: タクティクスオウガのトレーニングなど、本筋以外で稼げる場所を用意する。
blocks.translation: Providing places to earn experience outside the main storyline, such as Tactics Ogre’s training.

blocks.source: ただし、これはこれで面倒も……。
blocks.translation: However, this can be tedious in its own way…

blocks.source: 戦闘クリア時に全ての参加キャラクターに同一の経験値を渡す。
blocks.translation: Awarding the same amount of experience to every participating character when a battle is cleared.

blocks.source: 下の振分制のような要素を加味する。
blocks.translation: Adding elements like the distribution system described below.

blocks.source: などの方法が挙げられる。
blocks.translation: These are some possible approaches.

blocks.source: もっとも、この型の味は削れるかもしれないので、一長一短ではある。
blocks.translation: That said, they may diminish what makes this type distinctive, so there are advantages and disadvantages.

blocks.source: 振分制
blocks.translation: Distribution-Based

blocks.source: 「レベルアップ時」「メニュー画面」「セーブポイント」「施設（訓練所など）」で成長・習得させる能力や技能を決める。
blocks.translation: The player decides which abilities or skills to improve or learn at “level-up,” on the “menu screen,” at a “save point,” or at a “facility (such as a training center).”

blocks.source: 振り分けるためのポイントは戦闘で入手することが大半。
blocks.translation: The points used for distribution are usually acquired through battles.

blocks.source: 昨今では採用頻度の多い『スキルツリー』と呼ばれるものもこれに該当する。
blocks.translation: The “skill tree,” which has become increasingly common in recent years, also falls into this category.

blocks.source: 手順の多いシステムなので、ユーザインタフェースに関わるセンスも求められる。
blocks.translation: Since this system involves many steps, it also requires a good sense for user interface design.

blocks.source: 長所
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: 成長に自由度がある。
blocks.translation: Offers freedom in character growth.

blocks.source: システム設計の幅はとても広い。レベル制等との複合型も可能。
blocks.translation: The range of possible system designs is very broad. It can also be combined with systems such as level-based progression.

blocks.source: 短所
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: 頻繁な操作が必要となる場合がある（ＦＦ１０のスフィア盤など）。
blocks.translation: May require frequent input (such as Final Fantasy X's Sphere Grid).

blocks.source: ただし、対象となる項目の数を絞ることで軽減が可能。
blocks.translation: However, this can be mitigated by limiting the number of applicable elements.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples

blocks.source: 多種多様なので、以下の例をご覧いただきたい。伸ばすパラメータを決めるものもあれば、習得する技能を決めるものもある。特に通常のレベルアップによる能力アップを排除して、これ一本に成長システムを集約したＦＦ１０や１３は異色だ。
blocks.translation: There are many different variations, as shown in the examples below. Some let you choose which parameters to improve, while others let you choose which skills to learn. Final Fantasy X and XIII are particularly distinctive in that they eliminate stat increases from normal level-ups and consolidate the entire growth system into this one mechanic.

blocks.source: 女神転生シリーズ
blocks.translation: The Megami Tensei Series

blocks.source: レベルアップ時に伸ばしたい能力を選択する。
blocks.translation: Choose which abilities to improve when leveling up.

blocks.source: ＤＱ８（スキルマスター）
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest VIII (Skill Mastery)

blocks.source: レベルアップ時に習得したいスキルを選択する。
blocks.translation: Choose which skills to learn when leveling up.

blocks.source: ＦＦＴ（アビリティ）
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy Tactics (Abilities)

blocks.source: メニュー画面にて、戦闘で得たJPを消費してスキルを習得する。
blocks.translation: On the menu screen, spend JP earned in battle to learn skills.

blocks.source: ＦＦ１０（スフィア盤）
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy X (Sphere Grid)

blocks.source: レベルアップ時に上昇させたいパラメータやスキルを選択する。
blocks.translation: Choose which parameters or skills to increase when leveling up.

blocks.source: 熟練度制
blocks.translation: Skill Proficiency System

blocks.source: 戦闘で取った行動によって、能力が成長したり、技能を習得したりする。
blocks.translation: Depending on the actions taken in battle, abilities improve or skills are learned.

blocks.source: レベル制のように、一度にまとまった能力が上がるのではなく、個別に能力が成長していく。
blocks.translation: Unlike a level-based system, where a set of abilities increases all at once, individual abilities improve separately.

blocks.source: 長所
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: 好きな能力・技能を成長させることができるため自由度がある。
blocks.translation: Offers freedom because you can improve the abilities and skills you prefer.

blocks.source: 活用した技能が成長するというのは自然でわかりやすい。
blocks.translation: Having skills improve through use is natural and easy to understand.

blocks.source: 短所
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: 成長させたい能力に沿った戦闘行動を取る必要がある。
blocks.translation: You need to take battle actions that correspond to the abilities you want to improve.

blocks.source: つまり、自由に技能を成長させようと思うと、自由に戦闘できない。
blocks.translation: In other words, if you want to freely improve your skills, you cannot fight freely.

blocks.source: システム設計次第では、成長する能力値が極端になりやすい。
blocks.translation: Depending on the system design, the abilities that improve can easily become highly unbalanced.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples

blocks.source: ＦＦ２、サガシリーズ、テイルズオブシリーズ（技能の習得）
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy II, the SaGa series, and the Tales series (skill acquisition)

blocks.source: ＦＦ２とサガシリーズは、通常のレベル制を排除して、能力の上昇も熟練度制に統合している。
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy II and the SaGa series eliminate the conventional level-based system and integrate ability increases into the proficiency system as well.

blocks.source: テイルズオブシリーズは主に技能の習得について、熟練度性を採用しており、特定の技を使い込むことで、より上位の技を習得するようになっている。
blocks.translation: The Tales series primarily uses a proficiency-based system for learning skills, allowing characters to learn more advanced techniques by repeatedly using specific ones.

blocks.source: プレイヤーの個性が出る強化システムである反面、バランス調整は中々に難しい。
blocks.translation: Although this enhancement system allows players to express their individuality, balancing it is quite difficult.

blocks.source: 例えば、ロマンシングサガ２では、強い術を習得するためには、弱い術を何度も使い込んで、レベルを上げなければならない。サガ２では、重要能力である素早さを成長させられる条件が限られていて、上昇させるのが大変だった。
blocks.translation: For example, in Romancing SaGa 2, you must repeatedly use weaker spells and raise their levels in order to learn powerful spells. In SaGa 2, the conditions for improving the important Agility stat were limited, making it difficult to increase.

blocks.source: ＦＦ２やサガ２のような、能力が極端に偏る型に関しては、今ではほとんど見られなくなっている。やはり、バランス調整上の問題が大きかったのだろう。
blocks.translation: Systems in which abilities become extremely skewed, as in Final Fantasy II and SaGa 2, are now rarely seen. The problems they posed for balance adjustments were probably quite significant.

blocks.source: 閃き制
blocks.translation: Tech-Invention System

blocks.source: 戦闘中あるいは戦闘終了時に、特定の条件で新たな技能を習得する。
blocks.translation: During or at the end of battle, new skills are learned when certain conditions are met.

blocks.source: もっぱら技能の習得のみに使われる。
blocks.translation: It is used almost exclusively for learning skills.

blocks.source: ロマンシングサガ２から始まる閃きシステムが中でも有名。
blocks.translation: The most famous example is the Glimmer system, which began with Romancing SaGa 2.

blocks.source: これは戦闘中に武器で敵を攻撃した際に、確率で新しい技を習得するというもの。
blocks.translation: When attacking an enemy with a weapon during battle, there is a chance of learning a new technique.

blocks.source: ＦＦ６のモグが使う『おどり』もこれに近いかも。これは戦闘終了時にその時の戦闘地形によって、新しい技を覚えるというもの。
blocks.translation: The Dances used by Mog in Final Fantasy VI may also be similar. In that case, a new technique is learned at the end of battle based on the terrain of that battle.

blocks.source: このように技の習得条件に工夫を凝らすことで、新たな可能性が広がるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: By devising creative conditions for learning techniques in this way, you may be able to open up new possibilities.

blocks.source: 長所
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: 戦闘中に、技を閃くことで戦闘に変化を付ける事ができる。
blocks.translation: Having a character invent a technique during battle can add variety to the battle.

blocks.source: いつ技を閃くかわからないので、ワクワク感がある。
blocks.translation: Since you never know when a technique will be invented, it creates a sense of excitement.

blocks.source: 新しい技を見つけ出すことが楽しい。
blocks.translation: Discovering new techniques is fun.

blocks.source: 短所
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: 技を習得するための条件が分かり辛い。最悪、存在自体が埋もれてしまう技も……。
blocks.translation: The conditions for learning techniques can be difficult to understand. In the worst case, some techniques may be overlooked entirely…

blocks.source: 運が悪いと、いつまで経っても技を覚えないなんてことも。
blocks.translation: If you are unlucky, you may never learn a technique, no matter how long you wait.

blocks.source: 技を探すために、ゲーム進行が犠牲になりやすい。例えば、サガシリーズではボスに何度も通常攻撃を仕掛けて閃くのを待つなんてプレイスタイルがある。
blocks.translation: Game progression can easily be sacrificed in the search for techniques. For example, in the SaGa series, some players repeatedly use normal attacks against a boss and wait for a technique to be invented.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples

blocks.source: サガシリーズ（ロマンシングサガ２以降）
blocks.translation: The SaGa series (from Romancing SaGa 2 onward)

blocks.source: 職業制（転職制）
blocks.translation: Job System (Class-Change System)

blocks.source: 職業についた状態で戦闘などの修練を積むことで、能力が上昇したり、新しい技を覚えたりする。
blocks.translation: By undergoing training such as battles while in a class, characters improve their abilities and learn new techniques.

blocks.source: 転職（クラスチェンジ）によって、職業を変更しながら成長していく。作品によって、転職のルールは異なる。
blocks.translation: Characters grow by changing classes through job changes (class changes). The rules for changing classes vary from one game to another.

blocks.source: ＦＦ５やＤＱ６のように様々な職業に自由につける作品もあれば、ファイアーエムブレムのように上級職へと順当に上がっていく作品もある。
blocks.translation: Some games, such as FFV and DQVI, let you freely choose from various classes, while others, such as Fire Emblem, have characters progress steadily into advanced classes.

blocks.source: 以下の記述は、前者を念頭に置いている。
blocks.translation: The following discussion focuses on the former.

blocks.source: 長所
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: 職業を変更することで、同じキャラクターであってもプレイヤーの好きなようにアレンジできる。
blocks.translation: By changing classes, players can customize even the same character however they like.

blocks.source: 振分制や熟練度性と比較すると、良い意味で大雑把なので細かい操作は不要。
blocks.translation: Compared with point-allocation and proficiency systems, this system is broadly defined in a good way, so detailed management is unnecessary.

blocks.source: 転職による劇的な性能の変化はプレイヤーにとって強い魅力がある。
blocks.translation: The dramatic changes in performance caused by changing classes are highly appealing to players.

blocks.source: 新しい職業の入手は強いモチベーションとなる。
blocks.translation: Obtaining new classes provides strong motivation.

blocks.source: システム設計の自由度も高いので、制作者の工夫次第で様々な味付けが可能。
blocks.translation: The system offers a high degree of design freedom, allowing creators to add various touches depending on their ingenuity.

blocks.source: 短所
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: キャラクターの個性を強く打ち出すには向かない。
blocks.translation: It is not well suited to strongly highlighting a character's individuality.

blocks.source: 技能を習得するためには、一時的に弱い職業に転職する必要があることが多い。熟練度制と同じで、成長効率を重視すると自由なプレイができなくなる。作品の難易度が高くなるほど、こういった不満点は顕著になる。
blocks.translation: To learn skills, characters often need to temporarily change to a weaker class. As with the proficiency system, prioritizing growth efficiency prevents freeform play. The higher the game's difficulty, the more pronounced these frustrations become.

blocks.source: 個人的に、この短所で困ったのはＤＱ７。クリアするまで引き返せないイベントの際に、弱い職業に就いていたためボスが倒せなくて苦労した。
blocks.translation: Personally, I ran into this problem in DQVII. During an event where I could not turn back until it was cleared, I was in a weak class and had a hard time defeating the boss.

blocks.source: とはいえ、これは特定の場所でしか転職ができないＤＱ７の仕様による問題であるため、メニュー画面やセーブポイントで気軽に転職できるようにすれば、こういった問題は起こらない。
blocks.translation: That said, this was a problem caused by DQVII's design, which only allows class changes at specific locations. If players could change classes easily from the menu screen or at save points, problems like this would not occur.

blocks.source: 強化システムの中でも、劇的な変化があるためインパクトは強い。
blocks.translation: Among enhancement systems, this one has a strong impact because it produces dramatic changes.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples

blocks.source: 意外なところではペルソナシリーズ（３以降）も職業制に分類できそうだ。主人公がペルソナを切り替えることで、スキルや属性耐性など大幅に性能を変化させられるのが特徴だ。
blocks.translation: The Persona series (from Persona 3 onward) could also be classified as using a class system, although that may be unexpected. Its defining feature is that switching Personas allows the protagonist's performance to change substantially, including their skills and elemental resistances.

blocks.source: 装備制
blocks.translation: Equipment System

blocks.source: 手に入れたアイテムを身に着けることでキャラクターを強化したり、技能を習得したりする。基本的にはキャラクター自体が強くなるわけではない。レベル制に並んで、ほとんどのＲＰＧで採用されている。
blocks.translation: Characters are strengthened and learn skills by equipping items they obtain. Basically, the characters themselves do not become stronger. Alongside the level system, this is used in most RPGs.

blocks.source: レベル制と比較すると、応用の幅も広い。以下のような手段で個性化も可能だ。
blocks.translation: Compared with the level system, it also offers a wider range of applications. Character customization is possible through means such as the following.

blocks.source: 装備品の入手条件。基本はお金だが、魔石を集めて魔法書を手に入れるといったシステムも可能だ。
blocks.translation: Requirements for obtaining equipment. Money is the basic option, but systems such as collecting magic stones to obtain spellbooks are also possible.

blocks.source: 装備できる部位とその数。
blocks.translation: The equipment slots available and the number of items that can be equipped.

blocks.source: 装備品の性能。単に能力が上がるだけのものから、特殊な効果を持つもの。技能を習得するものまで。
blocks.translation: Equipment performance, ranging from items that simply raise abilities to those with special effects and those that teach skills.

blocks.source: 長所
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: シンプルで、プレイヤーが理解しやすい。
blocks.translation: It is simple and easy for players to understand.

blocks.source: お金を貯めて、新しい装備を手に入れるといった分かりやすい達成感を演出できる。
blocks.translation: It can create an easy-to-understand sense of accomplishment, such as saving money to obtain new equipment.

blocks.source: 装備品を他のキャラクターに付け替える自由によって、戦術の幅が広くなる。
blocks.translation: The freedom to transfer equipment between characters broadens the range of tactics.

blocks.source: 成長型の強化システムとの相性が比較的良い。
blocks.translation: It works relatively well with growth-based enhancement systems.

blocks.source: 上記のように応用の幅も広い。
blocks.translation: As described above, it also offers a wide range of applications.

blocks.source: 短所
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: コツコツとお金を貯めて購入した装備品であっても、いずれは使われなくなることが多い。
blocks.translation: Even equipment purchased with money painstakingly saved up will often eventually stop being used.

blocks.source: とはいえ、売ることである程度は戻ってくるけれど。
blocks.translation: That said, you can recover some of the cost by selling it.

blocks.source: 上述の通り、多くのＲＰＧで採用されている。
blocks.translation: As mentioned above, this system is used in many RPGs.

blocks.source: また、装飾品などの形式で能力変化に留まらない様々なスキルを付与することもある。
blocks.translation: Accessories and similar items can also grant various skills beyond simply changing abilities.

blocks.source: 軌跡シリーズのオーブメントなどは特徴的だろう。術の習得や能力の上昇などの恩恵が得られる上に、装備できる箇所も多いためカスタマイズ性が高い。
blocks.translation: The Orbments in the Trails series are a particularly distinctive example. In addition to providing benefits such as learning spells and raising abilities, they offer extensive customization because there are many slots in which they can be equipped.

blocks.source: 下記に亜種・応用例を記す。
blocks.translation: The following are variant and applied examples.

blocks.source: 装備＆キャラクター成長制
blocks.translation: Equipment and Character Growth System

blocks.source: 装備を身に付けた状態で、修練を積むことで、キャラクターの能力が上昇したり、新しい技を覚えたりする。上の職業制にも良く似ているが、職業と比較すると装備品の変更が容易であることが多い。
blocks.translation: By undergoing training while wearing equipment, characters improve their abilities and learn new techniques. This closely resembles the class system described above, but equipment can often be changed more easily than classes.

blocks.source: 長所
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: 職業性における転職ほど、インパクトはないが、キャラクターの個性を維持しながら、ある程度、成長に自由度を出すことができる。
blocks.translation: Although it is not as impactful as changing classes, it allows some freedom in character growth while preserving each character's individuality.

blocks.source: 職業の入手と同じく、装備品の入手がモチベーションになる。
blocks.translation: As with obtaining classes, obtaining equipment provides motivation.

blocks.source: 短所
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: 職業性と類似した問題点だが、成長効率を重視すると、自由な装備変更ができなくなる。例えば、強い武器でも、キャラクターの成長に役立たなければお役御免となる。
blocks.translation: This is similar to an issue with the class system: prioritizing growth efficiency prevents free equipment changes. For example, even a powerful weapon becomes obsolete if it does not help the character grow.

blocks.source: 成長のためにスキルを習得し終わった装備を次々と変更する必要があるなど、手間がかかりやすい。テイルズオブヴェスペリアなんて装備品とスキルの数が異常に多くて顕著。
blocks.translation: It can easily become a chore, since you may need to repeatedly change equipment after finishing learning the skills associated with each item in order to grow. Tales of Vesperia is a particularly notable example, with its exceptionally large number of equipment items and skills.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples

blocks.source: ＦＦ９はそのまんま。ＦＦ６は魔石による魔法習得システムを指している。
blocks.translation: FFIX is a straightforward example. FFVI refers to its magic-learning system using magicite.

blocks.source: ＦＦ９やテイルズオブヴェスペリアのような、武器防具にキャラクターの成長要素をくっつけるやり方は短所が出やすい。
blocks.translation: The approach used in games such as FFIX and Tales of Vesperia, which attaches character growth elements to weapons and armor, tends to expose these disadvantages.

blocks.source: ＦＦ６の魔石のように武器防具ではなく、別枠を設けたほうが無難かも。
blocks.translation: It may be safer to create a separate category rather than use weapons and armor, as with FFVI's magicite.

blocks.source: 装備＆装備成長制
blocks.translation: Equipment and Equipment Growth System

blocks.source: 装備を身につけた状態で、修練を積むことで、装備自体が強化される。あるいは、お金をかけて強化するパターンも。
blocks.translation: By training while wearing equipment, the equipment itself becomes stronger. Another option is to strengthen it by spending money.

blocks.source: ＦＦ７のマテリアが代表格。
blocks.translation: FFVII's Materia is a prime example.

blocks.source: 長所
blocks.translation: Advantages

blocks.source: 装備品の入手がモチベーションになるのは上と同じ。
blocks.translation: As with the system above, obtaining equipment serves as a source of motivation.

blocks.source: 装備品を他のキャラクターに付け替える自由によって、戦術の幅が広くなる。
blocks.translation: The freedom to move equipment between characters broadens the range of possible tactics.

blocks.source: 性質上、仲間の入れ替わりが激しいＲＰＧにもおすすめ。
blocks.translation: By its nature, this system is also recommended for RPGs with frequent changes to the party lineup.

blocks.source: 短所
blocks.translation: Disadvantages

blocks.source: せっかく強化した装備がゲーム進行に応じて、不要になることも。
blocks.translation: Equipment that you went to the trouble of strengthening may become unnecessary as the game progresses.

blocks.source: ただこれは、システム設計次第でどうにかなる。
blocks.translation: However, this can be addressed through system design.

blocks.source: 作品例
blocks.translation: Examples

blocks.source: 意図したものかどうかは分からないが、メンバーの離脱があるＦＦ７と相性の良いシステムだったりする。
blocks.translation: I don't know whether it was intentional, but this system happens to be a good fit for FFVII, where party members leave.

blocks.source: ＦＦ８のＧＦもこちらに分類できる。初代ペルソナ（女神異聞録）なども、仲間同士でペルソナの付け替えができるため同様だろう。
blocks.translation: FFVIII's Guardian Forces can also be classified here. The original Persona (Megami Ibunroku) would likely qualify as well, since Personas can be transferred between party members.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: やはり長年の実績があるだけあって、『レベル制』と『装備制』は欠点が少なく安定感がある。応用次第では、この２つだけでも、十分に長編ＲＰＧの強化システムとしてやっていけるはず。
blocks.translation: Given their many years of proven success, level-based and equipment-based systems have few drawbacks and offer a reliable foundation. Depending on how they are adapted, these two systems alone should be sufficient as enhancement systems for a long-form RPG.

blocks.source: どんな、強化システムを採用するかで悩んだならば、この組み合わせを軸としたシステム設計を考えてみると良いかも。
blocks.translation: If you're having trouble deciding what kind of enhancement system to adopt, it may be worth considering a system design centered on this combination.

blocks.source: とはいえ必ずしも、どの型が良いといったものではないので、色々と考えてみて欲しい。
blocks.translation: That said, there is no single type that is necessarily best, so I hope you'll consider various options.

blocks.source: 複数の強化システムを複合的に使うことを考えるとやり方はたくさんある。特に多いのは、『能力を上昇させる』場合と『技能を修得する』場合で異なる強化システムを採用しているパターンである。
blocks.translation: There are many possibilities when combining multiple enhancement systems. The most common pattern is to use different enhancement systems for increasing abilities and learning skills.

blocks.source: キャラクター毎に、技を習得する方法が異なるＦＦ６やシャドウハーツ２のような作品もあるし、ＧＢのサガやサガフロンティアに至っては、種族毎に全く能力成長の方法まで異なる。
blocks.translation: Some games, such as FFVI and Shadow Hearts 2, have different ways for each character to learn techniques. In the case of SaGa for the Game Boy and SaGa Frontier, even the method of ability growth differs entirely by race.

blocks.source: 注意点としては、自由な成長システムはそれ自体は面白くとも、戦闘自体がつまらなくなる危険性を秘めている。
blocks.translation: One thing to keep in mind is that although a flexible growth system can be interesting in itself, it also carries the risk of making the battles themselves boring.

blocks.source: 例えば、全員で「みだれうち」を連発するＦＦ５や、全員で、「剣の舞」（あるいは怒涛の羊）を連発するＤＱ７のように、戦闘内容がワンパターンになってしまう場合もある。
blocks.translation: For example, battles can become repetitive, as in FFV, where everyone repeatedly uses Rapid Fire, or DQVII, where everyone repeatedly uses Sword Dance (or Stampede).

blocks.source: 特に強力な回復技を全員が簡単に覚えられてしまった場合はバランス崩壊の危険が高い。そうならないためにも、時には何らかの制約を課すことも検討してみよう。
blocks.translation: The risk of the game's balance collapsing is particularly high if everyone can easily learn powerful healing techniques. To prevent this, consider imposing some kind of restriction from time to time.

lines.source: [[LINK_1]]レベル制（経験値・活躍分配型）[[/LINK_1]]

parts.source: レベル制（経験値・活躍分配型）
装備＆キャラクター成長制

lines.translation: [[LINK_1]]> Return to the RPG Design Guides index[[/LINK_1]]

texts.『強化システム』とはキャラクターの能力を伸ばしたり、新たな技を覚えるためのシステ: An “enhancement system” is a system for improving a character’s abilities or learning new techniques.
texts.ＲＰＧにおいては、戦闘システムに次いで作品のウリになることが多い。一般には『成長: In RPGs, it is often one of a game’s main selling points, second only to the battle system. It is generally also called a “growth system,” but since I am unsure whether it is appropriate to describe even equipment as “growth,” I will group everything together under enhancement systems in this section.
texts.強化システムは、主にキャラクター自体を強化する『成長型』と、装備を強化する『装備: Enhancement systems can primarily be divided into two types: “growth-based,” which strengthens the characters themselves, and “equipment-based,” which strengthens their equipment.
texts.一般的に成長型は経験値（ＦＦのＡＰなど、独自ポイントも含む）によって、強化する場: Generally, growth-based systems are often improved through experience points (including unique points such as Final Fantasy’s AP), while equipment-based systems often depend on money or material items. However, there are many exceptions.
texts.強化システムの目的は主に４つ挙げられる。: There are four main purposes for enhancement systems.
texts.変化をつけて、プレイヤーを飽きさせなくする。: Add variety and keep the player from becoming bored.
texts.努力の蓄積が実を結ぶことを表現し、達成感を演出する。: Express how accumulated effort bears fruit and create a sense of accomplishment.
texts.戦略性、戦術性を強化し、ゲーム性を向上させる。: Enhance strategic and tactical depth to improve the gameplay.
texts.ストーリーを補強する。長い冒険の中でキャラクターを鍛え上げたのだからこそ、強敵に: Reinforce the story. Because the characters have honed their skills throughout a long adventure, defeating powerful enemies becomes more convincing.
texts.何十時間と掛かる長編ＲＰＧにおいて、プレイヤーを退屈させないためには、強化システ: In a long-form RPG that takes dozens of hours to complete, an enhancement system is essential for keeping the player from getting bored.
texts.戦闘する → レベルが上がって、より強い敵に勝てるようになる → 強敵と戦闘する: Fight → Level up and become able to defeat stronger enemies → Fight a powerful enemy → …
texts.といったループは単純ながら、プレイヤーにとって強力な原動力に成りうる。ＲＰＧの基: Although simple, a loop like this can be a powerful motivating force for players. You could even call it one of the fundamental elements of an RPG.
texts.そんなわけで、ＲＰＧにおいて欠かせない強化システムを取り扱ってみる。: With that in mind, I will take a look at the enhancement systems that are indispensable to RPGs.
texts.例によって、市販ＲＰＧでよく使用されているシステムを分類してみた。: As usual, I have classified systems commonly used in commercial RPGs.
texts.戦闘を行うことで、経験値を入手する。経験値が一定に達すると、レベルが上がると同時: Characters gain experience points by fighting battles. When their experience reaches a certain amount, they level up and their overall abilities increase.
texts.多くの作品で採用されているが、これだけでは単純なので、他のシステムと組み合わせら: Although this system is used in many games, it is simple on its own, so it is often combined with other systems.
texts.分かりやすくプレイヤーも制作者も手間がかからない。: It is easy to understand and requires little effort from either the player or the developer.
texts.キャラクター毎の個性を維持しやすい。: It is easy to preserve each character’s individuality.
texts.単純ゆえにバランス調整も比較的に容易。: Because it is simple, balancing is comparatively easy.
texts.単純ゆえに自由度は低い。: Because it is simple, it offers little freedom.
texts.ＳＲＰＧでよく用いられるレベル制。: A level-based system often used in strategy RPGs.
texts.戦闘で敵にとどめを刺すなど、活躍したキャラに対して経験値を与える。: Experience points are awarded to characters who make significant contributions in battle, such as delivering the finishing blow to an enemy.
texts.上と異なり参加するだけで経験値が手に入るわけではない。: Unlike the system above, characters do not gain experience simply by participating.
texts.誰を優先して育てるかを考える楽しさがある。: It is fun to consider which characters to prioritize when training.
texts.活躍できないキャラは成長の機会に乏しくなる。: Characters who cannot contribute have few opportunities to grow.
texts.レベルを上げたいキャラでとどめを刺すために、周りの強いキャラでチクチクとボスのＨ: Players may have to perform tedious adjustments, such as repeatedly chipping away at a boss’s HP with stronger surrounding characters so that the character they want to level up can deliver the finishing blow.
texts.スパロボの幸運（経験値＆お金倍増）などの精神コマンドは、この短所をさらに顕著にし: Mental Commands such as Super Robot Wars’ Luck (which doubles experience and money) make this disadvantage even more pronounced.
texts.「工夫をすると経験値が増える」ということは「工夫をしないと経験値が減る（相対的に: That is because “using ingenuity increases your experience” is almost equivalent to “not using ingenuity decreases your experience (relatively speaking).” You have to be careful every time you defeat an enemy.
texts.タクティクスオウガのトレーニングなど、本筋以外で稼げる場所を用意する。: Providing places to earn experience outside the main storyline, such as Tactics Ogre’s training.
texts.ただし、これはこれで面倒も……。: However, this can be tedious in its own way…
texts.戦闘クリア時に全ての参加キャラクターに同一の経験値を渡す。: Awarding the same amount of experience to every participating character when a battle is cleared.
texts.下の振分制のような要素を加味する。: Adding elements like the distribution system described below.
texts.もっとも、この型の味は削れるかもしれないので、一長一短ではある。: That said, they may diminish what makes this type distinctive, so there are advantages and disadvantages.
texts.「レベルアップ時」「メニュー画面」「セーブポイント」「施設（訓練所など）」で成長: The player decides which abilities or skills to improve or learn at “level-up,” on the “menu screen,” at a “save point,” or at a “facility (such as a training center).”
texts.振り分けるためのポイントは戦闘で入手することが大半。: The points used for distribution are usually acquired through battles.
texts.昨今では採用頻度の多い『スキルツリー』と呼ばれるものもこれに該当する。: The “skill tree,” which has become increasingly common in recent years, also falls into this category.
texts.手順の多いシステムなので、ユーザインタフェースに関わるセンスも求められる。: Since this system involves many steps, it also requires a good sense for user interface design.
texts.システム設計の幅はとても広い。レベル制等との複合型も可能。: The range of possible system designs is very broad. It can also be combined with systems such as level-based progression.
texts.頻繁な操作が必要となる場合がある（ＦＦ１０のスフィア盤など）。: May require frequent input (such as Final Fantasy X's Sphere Grid).
texts.ただし、対象となる項目の数を絞ることで軽減が可能。: However, this can be mitigated by limiting the number of applicable elements.
texts.多種多様なので、以下の例をご覧いただきたい。伸ばすパラメータを決めるものもあれば: There are many different variations, as shown in the examples below. Some let you choose which parameters to improve, while others let you choose which skills to learn. Final Fantasy X and XIII are particularly distinctive in that they eliminate stat increases from normal level-ups and consolidate the entire growth system into this one mechanic.
texts.レベルアップ時に伸ばしたい能力を選択する。: Choose which abilities to improve when leveling up.
texts.レベルアップ時に習得したいスキルを選択する。: Choose which skills to learn when leveling up.
texts.メニュー画面にて、戦闘で得たJPを消費してスキルを習得する。: On the menu screen, spend JP earned in battle to learn skills.
texts.レベルアップ時に上昇させたいパラメータやスキルを選択する。: Choose which parameters or skills to increase when leveling up.
texts.戦闘で取った行動によって、能力が成長したり、技能を習得したりする。: Depending on the actions taken in battle, abilities improve or skills are learned.
texts.レベル制のように、一度にまとまった能力が上がるのではなく、個別に能力が成長してい: Unlike a level-based system, where a set of abilities increases all at once, individual abilities improve separately.
texts.好きな能力・技能を成長させることができるため自由度がある。: Offers freedom because you can improve the abilities and skills you prefer.
texts.活用した技能が成長するというのは自然でわかりやすい。: Having skills improve through use is natural and easy to understand.
texts.成長させたい能力に沿った戦闘行動を取る必要がある。: You need to take battle actions that correspond to the abilities you want to improve.
texts.つまり、自由に技能を成長させようと思うと、自由に戦闘できない。: In other words, if you want to freely improve your skills, you cannot fight freely.
texts.システム設計次第では、成長する能力値が極端になりやすい。: Depending on the system design, the abilities that improve can easily become highly unbalanced.
texts.ＦＦ２、サガシリーズ、テイルズオブシリーズ（技能の習得）: Final Fantasy II, the SaGa series, and the Tales series (skill acquisition)
texts.ＦＦ２とサガシリーズは、通常のレベル制を排除して、能力の上昇も熟練度制に統合して: Final Fantasy II and the SaGa series eliminate the conventional level-based system and integrate ability increases into the proficiency system as well.
texts.テイルズオブシリーズは主に技能の習得について、熟練度性を採用しており、特定の技を: The Tales series primarily uses a proficiency-based system for learning skills, allowing characters to learn more advanced techniques by repeatedly using specific ones.
texts.プレイヤーの個性が出る強化システムである反面、バランス調整は中々に難しい。: Although this enhancement system allows players to express their individuality, balancing it is quite difficult.
texts.例えば、ロマンシングサガ２では、強い術を習得するためには、弱い術を何度も使い込ん: For example, in Romancing SaGa 2, you must repeatedly use weaker spells and raise their levels in order to learn powerful spells. In SaGa 2, the conditions for improving the important Agility stat were limited, making it difficult to increase.
texts.ＦＦ２やサガ２のような、能力が極端に偏る型に関しては、今ではほとんど見られなくな: Systems in which abilities become extremely skewed, as in Final Fantasy II and SaGa 2, are now rarely seen. The problems they posed for balance adjustments were probably quite significant.
texts.戦闘中あるいは戦闘終了時に、特定の条件で新たな技能を習得する。: During or at the end of battle, new skills are learned when certain conditions are met.
texts.もっぱら技能の習得のみに使われる。: It is used almost exclusively for learning skills.
texts.ロマンシングサガ２から始まる閃きシステムが中でも有名。: The most famous example is the Glimmer system, which began with Romancing SaGa 2.
texts.これは戦闘中に武器で敵を攻撃した際に、確率で新しい技を習得するというもの。: When attacking an enemy with a weapon during battle, there is a chance of learning a new technique.
texts.ＦＦ６のモグが使う『おどり』もこれに近いかも。これは戦闘終了時にその時の戦闘地形: The Dances used by Mog in Final Fantasy VI may also be similar. In that case, a new technique is learned at the end of battle based on the terrain of that battle.
texts.このように技の習得条件に工夫を凝らすことで、新たな可能性が広がるかもしれない。: By devising creative conditions for learning techniques in this way, you may be able to open up new possibilities.
texts.戦闘中に、技を閃くことで戦闘に変化を付ける事ができる。: Having a character invent a technique during battle can add variety to the battle.
texts.いつ技を閃くかわからないので、ワクワク感がある。: Since you never know when a technique will be invented, it creates a sense of excitement.
texts.技を習得するための条件が分かり辛い。最悪、存在自体が埋もれてしまう技も……。: The conditions for learning techniques can be difficult to understand. In the worst case, some techniques may be overlooked entirely…
texts.運が悪いと、いつまで経っても技を覚えないなんてことも。: If you are unlucky, you may never learn a technique, no matter how long you wait.
texts.技を探すために、ゲーム進行が犠牲になりやすい。例えば、サガシリーズではボスに何度: Game progression can easily be sacrificed in the search for techniques. For example, in the SaGa series, some players repeatedly use normal attacks against a boss and wait for a technique to be invented.
texts.サガシリーズ（ロマンシングサガ２以降）: The SaGa series (from Romancing SaGa 2 onward)
texts.職業についた状態で戦闘などの修練を積むことで、能力が上昇したり、新しい技を覚えた: By undergoing training such as battles while in a class, characters improve their abilities and learn new techniques.
texts.転職（クラスチェンジ）によって、職業を変更しながら成長していく。作品によって、転: Characters grow by changing classes through job changes (class changes). The rules for changing classes vary from one game to another.
texts.ＦＦ５やＤＱ６のように様々な職業に自由につける作品もあれば、ファイアーエムブレム: Some games, such as FFV and DQVI, let you freely choose from various classes, while others, such as Fire Emblem, have characters progress steadily into advanced classes.
texts.以下の記述は、前者を念頭に置いている。: The following discussion focuses on the former.
texts.職業を変更することで、同じキャラクターであってもプレイヤーの好きなようにアレンジ: By changing classes, players can customize even the same character however they like.
texts.振分制や熟練度性と比較すると、良い意味で大雑把なので細かい操作は不要。: Compared with point-allocation and proficiency systems, this system is broadly defined in a good way, so detailed management is unnecessary.
texts.転職による劇的な性能の変化はプレイヤーにとって強い魅力がある。: The dramatic changes in performance caused by changing classes are highly appealing to players.
texts.新しい職業の入手は強いモチベーションとなる。: Obtaining new classes provides strong motivation.
texts.システム設計の自由度も高いので、制作者の工夫次第で様々な味付けが可能。: The system offers a high degree of design freedom, allowing creators to add various touches depending on their ingenuity.
texts.キャラクターの個性を強く打ち出すには向かない。: It is not well suited to strongly highlighting a character's individuality.
texts.技能を習得するためには、一時的に弱い職業に転職する必要があることが多い。熟練度制: To learn skills, characters often need to temporarily change to a weaker class. As with the proficiency system, prioritizing growth efficiency prevents freeform play. The higher the game's difficulty, the more pronounced these frustrations become.
texts.個人的に、この短所で困ったのはＤＱ７。クリアするまで引き返せないイベントの際に、: Personally, I ran into this problem in DQVII. During an event where I could not turn back until it was cleared, I was in a weak class and had a hard time defeating the boss.
texts.とはいえ、これは特定の場所でしか転職ができないＤＱ７の仕様による問題であるため、: That said, this was a problem caused by DQVII's design, which only allows class changes at specific locations. If players could change classes easily from the menu screen or at save points, problems like this would not occur.
texts.強化システムの中でも、劇的な変化があるためインパクトは強い。: Among enhancement systems, this one has a strong impact because it produces dramatic changes.
texts.意外なところではペルソナシリーズ（３以降）も職業制に分類できそうだ。主人公がペル: The Persona series (from Persona 3 onward) could also be classified as using a class system, although that may be unexpected. Its defining feature is that switching Personas allows the protagonist's performance to change substantially, including their skills and elemental resistances.
texts.手に入れたアイテムを身に着けることでキャラクターを強化したり、技能を習得したりす: Characters are strengthened and learn skills by equipping items they obtain. Basically, the characters themselves do not become stronger. Alongside the level system, this is used in most RPGs.
texts.レベル制と比較すると、応用の幅も広い。以下のような手段で個性化も可能だ。: Compared with the level system, it also offers a wider range of applications. Character customization is possible through means such as the following.
texts.装備品の入手条件。基本はお金だが、魔石を集めて魔法書を手に入れるといったシステム: Requirements for obtaining equipment. Money is the basic option, but systems such as collecting magic stones to obtain spellbooks are also possible.
texts.装備できる部位とその数。: The equipment slots available and the number of items that can be equipped.
texts.装備品の性能。単に能力が上がるだけのものから、特殊な効果を持つもの。技能を習得す: Equipment performance, ranging from items that simply raise abilities to those with special effects and those that teach skills.
texts.シンプルで、プレイヤーが理解しやすい。: It is simple and easy for players to understand.
texts.お金を貯めて、新しい装備を手に入れるといった分かりやすい達成感を演出できる。: It can create an easy-to-understand sense of accomplishment, such as saving money to obtain new equipment.
texts.装備品を他のキャラクターに付け替える自由によって、戦術の幅が広くなる。: The freedom to move equipment between characters broadens the range of possible tactics.
texts.成長型の強化システムとの相性が比較的良い。: It works relatively well with growth-based enhancement systems.
texts.上記のように応用の幅も広い。: As described above, it also offers a wide range of applications.
texts.コツコツとお金を貯めて購入した装備品であっても、いずれは使われなくなることが多い: Even equipment purchased with money painstakingly saved up will often eventually stop being used.
texts.とはいえ、売ることである程度は戻ってくるけれど。: That said, you can recover some of the cost by selling it.
texts.上述の通り、多くのＲＰＧで採用されている。: As mentioned above, this system is used in many RPGs.
texts.また、装飾品などの形式で能力変化に留まらない様々なスキルを付与することもある。: Accessories and similar items can also grant various skills beyond simply changing abilities.
texts.軌跡シリーズのオーブメントなどは特徴的だろう。術の習得や能力の上昇などの恩恵が得: The Orbments in the Trails series are a particularly distinctive example. In addition to providing benefits such as learning spells and raising abilities, they offer extensive customization because there are many slots in which they can be equipped.
texts.下記に亜種・応用例を記す。: The following are variant and applied examples.
texts.装備を身に付けた状態で、修練を積むことで、キャラクターの能力が上昇したり、新しい: By undergoing training while wearing equipment, characters improve their abilities and learn new techniques. This closely resembles the class system described above, but equipment can often be changed more easily than classes.
texts.職業性における転職ほど、インパクトはないが、キャラクターの個性を維持しながら、あ: Although it is not as impactful as changing classes, it allows some freedom in character growth while preserving each character's individuality.
texts.職業の入手と同じく、装備品の入手がモチベーションになる。: As with obtaining classes, obtaining equipment provides motivation.
texts.職業性と類似した問題点だが、成長効率を重視すると、自由な装備変更ができなくなる。: This is similar to an issue with the class system: prioritizing growth efficiency prevents free equipment changes. For example, even a powerful weapon becomes obsolete if it does not help the character grow.
texts.成長のためにスキルを習得し終わった装備を次々と変更する必要があるなど、手間がかか: It can easily become a chore, since you may need to repeatedly change equipment after finishing learning the skills associated with each item in order to grow. Tales of Vesperia is a particularly notable example, with its exceptionally large number of equipment items and skills.
texts.ＦＦ９はそのまんま。ＦＦ６は魔石による魔法習得システムを指している。: FFIX is a straightforward example. FFVI refers to its magic-learning system using magicite.
texts.ＦＦ９やテイルズオブヴェスペリアのような、武器防具にキャラクターの成長要素をくっ: The approach used in games such as FFIX and Tales of Vesperia, which attaches character growth elements to weapons and armor, tends to expose these disadvantages.
texts.ＦＦ６の魔石のように武器防具ではなく、別枠を設けたほうが無難かも。: It may be safer to create a separate category rather than use weapons and armor, as with FFVI's magicite.
texts.装備を身につけた状態で、修練を積むことで、装備自体が強化される。あるいは、お金を: By training while wearing equipment, the equipment itself becomes stronger. Another option is to strengthen it by spending money.
texts.ＦＦ７のマテリアが代表格。: FFVII's Materia is a prime example.
texts.装備品の入手がモチベーションになるのは上と同じ。: As with the system above, obtaining equipment serves as a source of motivation.
texts.性質上、仲間の入れ替わりが激しいＲＰＧにもおすすめ。: By its nature, this system is also recommended for RPGs with frequent changes to the party lineup.
texts.せっかく強化した装備がゲーム進行に応じて、不要になることも。: Equipment that you went to the trouble of strengthening may become unnecessary as the game progresses.
texts.ただこれは、システム設計次第でどうにかなる。: However, this can be addressed through system design.
texts.意図したものかどうかは分からないが、メンバーの離脱があるＦＦ７と相性の良いシステ: I don't know whether it was intentional, but this system happens to be a good fit for FFVII, where party members leave.
texts.ＦＦ８のＧＦもこちらに分類できる。初代ペルソナ（女神異聞録）なども、仲間同士でペ: FFVIII's Guardian Forces can also be classified here. The original Persona (Megami Ibunroku) would likely qualify as well, since Personas can be transferred between party members.
texts.やはり長年の実績があるだけあって、『レベル制』と『装備制』は欠点が少なく安定感が: Given their many years of proven success, level-based and equipment-based systems have few drawbacks and offer a reliable foundation. Depending on how they are adapted, these two systems alone should be sufficient as enhancement systems for a long-form RPG.
texts.どんな、強化システムを採用するかで悩んだならば、この組み合わせを軸としたシステム: If you're having trouble deciding what kind of enhancement system to adopt, it may be worth considering a system design centered on this combination.
texts.とはいえ必ずしも、どの型が良いといったものではないので、色々と考えてみて欲しい。: That said, there is no single type that is necessarily best, so I hope you'll consider various options.
texts.複数の強化システムを複合的に使うことを考えるとやり方はたくさんある。特に多いのは: There are many possibilities when combining multiple enhancement systems. The most common pattern is to use different enhancement systems for increasing abilities and learning skills.
texts.キャラクター毎に、技を習得する方法が異なるＦＦ６やシャドウハーツ２のような作品も: Some games, such as FFVI and Shadow Hearts 2, have different ways for each character to learn techniques. In the case of SaGa for the Game Boy and SaGa Frontier, even the method of ability growth differs entirely by race.
texts.注意点としては、自由な成長システムはそれ自体は面白くとも、戦闘自体がつまらなくな: One thing to keep in mind is that although a flexible growth system can be interesting in itself, it also carries the risk of making the battles themselves boring.
texts.例えば、全員で「みだれうち」を連発するＦＦ５や、全員で、「剣の舞」（あるいは怒涛: For example, battles can become repetitive, as in FFV, where everyone repeatedly uses Rapid Fire, or DQVII, where everyone repeatedly uses Sword Dance (or Stampede).
texts.特に強力な回復技を全員が簡単に覚えられてしまった場合はバランス崩壊の危険が高い。: The risk of the game's balance collapsing is particularly high if everyone can easily learn powerful healing techniques. To prevent this, consider imposing some kind of restriction from time to time.
